decks.summary: Taboo-compliant standard Tommy: soak assets like Cherished Keepsake, Leather Coat and Tetsuo Mori pay him when they fall and shuffle back, while Becky, Enchanted Blade and Guard Dog fight.
Blessed Tommy at 30 XP: Spirit of Humanity on Peter Sylvestre and Jessica Hyde makes bless every turn, sealed on Holy Spear for big attacks and recycled with Hallow.
The level 0 start of Holy Muldy: soak assets and Tetsuo Mori, .35 Winchesters and Becky to fight, and Rite of Sanctification and Keep Faith laying the groundwork for bless.
Shotgun Tommy who builds bless with Spirit of Humanity, Favor of the Sun and Keep Faith, upgrades the Shotgun with Custom Modifications and Venturer, and reloads through Relentless.
Standalone Tommy whose Beat Cops, Tetsuo Mori and Solemn Vow soak for the team and pay out when they fall, with Well Prepared and Enchanted Blade to fight; 29 XP.
Swarm-busting Tommy for Dream-Eaters who throws Mk 1 Grenades and shoots Becky, with Brother Xavier, Jessica Hyde, Tetsuo Mori and Leather Coat soaking the fallout and paying him for it.
Multiplayer Tommy with Shotgun, Becky and Bandolier for heavy damage, two Charismas of soaking allies, and Peter Sylvestre and Jessica Hyde for healing; few clues, no evasion.
Deck-seeing Tommy who uses Stick to the Plan, Backpack and Salvage to see thirty cards on turn one, then fights with Becky under Custom Modifications and Telescopic Sight.
Standalone Tommy who replays Agency Backup and Brother Xavier cheaply from his discard pile with A Chance Encounter and Calling in Favors, soaking hits and shooting .45 Thompsons.
Runic Axe Tommy who recycles the Axe with Scavenging, Salvage and Short Supply to fight, move and find clues with it, adding Old Keyring and Professor Webb for more clues.
